boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten FGCU study environments spanning bookable library rooms, computer-equipped spaces, academic support, and a reservable quiet retreat. The title is editorial framing, not a crowding claim.

cards.title: Spread Out Around the Round Tables
cards.subtitle: Wilson G. Bradshaw Library · LIB 121
cards.notes: Bring a collaborative assignment and use the round tables, whiteboard, projector screen, and AirMedia-equipped teaching setup.
cards.short_summary: A 63-seat library room configured for table-based collaboration and presentations.
cards.evidence_claim: FGCU lists LIB 121 with capacity for 63, round tables and chairs, a whiteboard, projector screen, AirMedia, and presentation technology.
cards.access_notes: Check the university room-availability calendar and obtain reservation confirmation before using the room for a meeting or event.

cards.title: Connect a Small Group to AirMedia
cards.subtitle: Wilson G. Bradshaw Library · LIB 221
cards.notes: Reserve this compact room when a 23-person group needs wireless presentation technology without a large auditorium layout.
cards.short_summary: A smaller approval-controlled library room with AirMedia and lecture-capture technology.
cards.evidence_claim: FGCU lists LIB 221 with capacity for 23, AirMedia, lecture-capture technology, a technology podium, and an approval requirement.
cards.access_notes: Approval is required; check availability and submit the applicable FGCU reservation request before use.

cards.title: Work Through Software Side by Side
cards.subtitle: Wilson G. Bradshaw Library · LIB 222
cards.notes: Choose this room for computer-based group work, then confirm approval before relying on its PC-lab seating and projection equipment.
cards.short_summary: A 50-seat, approval-controlled PC lab inside the university library.
cards.evidence_claim: FGCU identifies LIB 222 as a 50-seat PC lab with computers, a projector screen, lecture-capture technology, and required approval.
cards.access_notes: Approval is required; verify current availability through Campus Reservations and wait for confirmation.

cards.title: Put the Whiteboard at the Center
cards.subtitle: Wilson G. Bradshaw Library · LIB 225B
cards.notes: Use the conference-style layout for a focused team session, with the whiteboard and projector screen supporting shared problem-solving.
cards.short_summary: A 15-seat conference room suited to discussion and projected material.
cards.evidence_claim: FGCU lists LIB 225B with capacity for 15, conference-style seating, a projector screen, telephone, whiteboard, and required approval.
cards.access_notes: Approval is required; request the room through the applicable university reservation process.

cards.title: Gather Around One Conference Table
cards.subtitle: Wilson G. Bradshaw Library · LIB 431
cards.notes: Bring a discussion-heavy project here when a 12-seat conference arrangement and television fit the work better than classroom rows.
cards.short_summary: A compact fourth-floor conference-style room with a television.
cards.evidence_claim: FGCU lists LIB 431 with capacity for 12, conference-style seating, and a television.
cards.access_notes: Check current room availability and reservation requirements before planning a study session here.

cards.title: Build the Session Around a PC Lab
cards.subtitle: Wilson G. Bradshaw Library · LIB 438
cards.notes: Plan software practice or data work around the installed PCs, then use AirMedia, the projector, and whiteboard to compare results.
cards.short_summary: A 44-seat library computer lab with substantial presentation equipment.
cards.evidence_claim: FGCU lists LIB 438 as a 44-seat computer lab with PC-lab seating, AirMedia, a projector screen, whiteboard, and lecture-capture technology.
cards.access_notes: Confirm the room's availability and applicable reservation or instructional-use restrictions before entering.

cards.title: Take a PC-Based Review to the Screen
cards.subtitle: Wilson G. Bradshaw Library · LIB 441
cards.notes: Reserve ahead for a computer-centered review session using the room's PCs, smart projection technology, and shared whiteboard.
cards.short_summary: An approval-controlled, 32-seat PC lab with smart projection.
cards.evidence_claim: FGCU lists LIB 441 with capacity for 32, PCs, PC-lab seating, smart projection, a projector screen, whiteboard, and required approval.
cards.access_notes: Approval is required; verify availability and receive confirmation through the university reservation process.

cards.title: Face Forward for a Guided Review
cards.subtitle: Wilson G. Bradshaw Library · LIB 443
cards.notes: Use the tablet-armchair layout for a structured review, with AirMedia, projection, and a whiteboard available for worked examples.
cards.short_summary: A 49-seat presentation room arranged with individual tablet armchairs.
cards.evidence_claim: FGCU lists LIB 443 with capacity for 49, tablet armchairs, AirMedia, a projector screen, technology podium, telephone, and whiteboard.
cards.access_notes: Check the current availability calendar and confirm whether a reservation is required for the planned use.

cards.title: Pair Study Time With Academic Support
cards.subtitle: Library West · first and second floors
cards.notes: Start at the first-floor office, then use second-floor writing or tutoring services and request an accessible table if needed.
cards.short_summary: Library West study support with coaching, tutoring, writing consultations, and accessible work areas.
cards.evidence_claim: FGCU states that the Center for Academic Achievement occupies Library West, with its office on the first floor, writing and tutoring on the second, and accessible tables, chairs, and assistive technology.
cards.access_notes: Services are for FGCU students; consult the Center for Academic Achievement for appointment and consultation availability.

cards.title: Book a Softer Setting for Quiet Work
cards.subtitle: Modular 2 · reservable retreat
cards.notes: Book time before arriving, then use the soft lighting, sectional seating, and calm setting for quiet reading or a low-key meeting.
cards.short_summary: A reservable campus retreat designed with soft lighting and comfortable seating.
cards.evidence_claim: FGCU documents The Nesting Place in Modular 2 as a bookable quiet study and meeting space for students, staff, and faculty, with soft lighting and comfortable seating.
cards.source_title: Take a Moment to Recharge at The Nesting Place
cards.access_notes: Students, staff, and faculty must book time; consult the linked Nesting Place booking resource for current openings.

warnings: The title's “Claimed by 9am” phrase is editorial framing; no claim about crowding or student arrival behavior is made.
Room availability and approval status can change with classes and events; users should verify the live university calendar and obtain confirmation where required.
The Nesting Place source was published outside the template's 180-day freshness window, but it remains the university's direct descriptive page; current booking availability should be reconfirmed.
